method: Read all four proposals and checked source/binary binding of every citation. Directly checked r2 and r3 CSR partitions, complete local row/nonzero traversals, timed repetition loops, and emitted native loads/multiply/add/stores plus all three loop backedges. r2 uses root send/receive of adjacent slices; r3 uses Scatterv and rebased delimiters. No missing repetitions or CSR work identified.
timestamp_provenance: Conservative enclosing interval, not exact review duration: 22:07:09Z is the parent-observed launch lower bound and 22:09:49Z was clock-observed by the reviewer near completion. The original 22:05:00Z start was guessed and is rejected; its original proposal is retained. Scientific findings are unchanged.
